en:
Hey there. I'm Tomoharu Hosoda.
Your name was {a}{f:|}, right?
Wow, you really are unlucky.
Getting into this school of all places.
This school, you see, is a treasure trove of spirits.
I've heard that spirits gather in certain places, and this is exactly one of them.
This is a mammoth high school with nearly five hundred students in each year, so it wouldn't be strange for an accident or two to happen.
But the accidents here aren't normal ones.
They're abnormal, to put it bluntly.
Everyone says it's just their imagination, but anyone with a strong sixth sense can tell it's no ordinary thing.
Honestly, I agonized over whether to come to this school at all.{p}

I'd felt it ever since the entrance exam.
An abnormally strong spiritual aura.
I have about as much of a sixth sense as the next person.
But only as much as the next person.
And even I felt a powerful aura.
An aura strong enough to give me goosebumps all over.
To be honest, I don't think I did very well on the exam.
I bet everyone else scored a lot higher than me.{p}

Even so, I passed.
I was shocked when I saw the results posted.
That's when it occurred to me.
Maybe this school was calling me.
So I figured it was fate and resigned myself to it.
I didn't get into a single other high school, anyway.
Honestly, if I hadn't come here, I'd have spent a year out of school, retaking entrance exams.
I didn't want that, and my family wouldn't have allowed it either.
Maybe it was decided long ago that things would turn out this way.
And once I actually started here, it turned out to be a pretty livable place, all things considered.
Though it might be more accurate to say I got used to it.{p}

But at that entrance exam, it was really incredible.
I could actually see the aura drifting through the air.
Maybe I felt it that strongly because it was my first time at this school.
There was no way I could concentrate on any exam.
I couldn't believe the people around me were acting so normal.
Oh yeah, and back then, there was another guy besides me who'd gone just as pale.{p}

What was his name again?
...Nakano, I think it was.
He seemed timid, a nervous sort of guy.
But just like me, he was wrapped in that suffocating aura, and it was making him feel sick.
I'm sure he thought the same about me, too.
Our eyes met during the break.
Then he gave me a little bow and waved at me.
I hurriedly waved back.
Then he got up from his seat and came over to me.{p}

"Hey. How's it going?"
I said hello back.
Up close, he looked like a friendly guy.
I couldn't spot any of my friends anywhere.
A few of them must have come to take the exam here too, but the place is huge.
Part of me was feeling a little lonely on my own.
He probably felt the same way.
We hit it off.
We became friends right away.
"How'd you do on that exam?"
"Terrible. I couldn't do any of it."
"Me neither."
We were chatting about silly stuff like that, and before we knew it, the break was over.{p}

He and I had both noticed the strange aura enveloping the whole school, but neither of us said a word about it.
When the second-period exam ended, Nakano came over to me again.{p}

"Want to go to the restroom?"
"Yeah, I was just thinking of going too."
Truth is, I'd been holding it for a while.
Instead of solving the exam questions, I'd spent the whole time watching the clock, wishing it would end.
I bet it was the same for him.
Breaks go by in a flash, you know.
It was bound to be crowded, so if we didn't hurry, we'd run out of time.
We walked briskly to the restroom.{p}

"Ah..."
We cried out and stopped in our tracks at almost the same moment.
And then we looked at each other.
"...You can see it too?"
I nodded silently at his words.
I'd seen something unbelievable there.
What do you think I saw?{p}

Lots of hands were reaching out of the restroom.
Dozens and dozens of hands were sticking out of the restroom, beckoning, as if to say 'come here, come here.'
There were so many hands crammed together that you couldn't even see inside.
It looked like a packed rush-hour train, with people jostling at the little doors, each trying to get off first.
The only difference was that there were no people, just countless hands.
The hands also looked like they were trying to escape from something.
Those weren't human.
They were spirits, no doubt about it.
There was a crowd in front of the restroom, everyone waiting their turn, but I couldn't believe it.
How could they bear to walk into a restroom like that?{p}

"What do we do?"
I was startled.
Nakano was looking at me so helplessly.
He must have been seeing that sight too...
Or was he seeing something different?
"Even if you ask me what to do..."
That's what I said, but I didn't think I could hold it.
I was about to wet myself.
Come on, all those people were going in there.
It had to be my imagination.
That's what I told myself.
But the fear wouldn't go away.
"What do we do?"
Nakano asked again.{p}What should I do?
Go into the restroom
Hold it in
Look for another restroom

"Let's not.
You can see those hands too, can't you?"
"...Yeah."
He gave a small nod.
So he could see them too.
We held it in and went back to the exam room.{p}

By third period, I was in no state to take an exam.
Greasy sweat was seeping out of me, and all I could do was pray for it to end soon.
I even thought about giving up on the exam halfway through.
I stopped caring about the exam at all; I just gritted my teeth and kept my head down.
I felt like I was about to pass out.
Just then, there was a sudden clatter diagonally behind me.{p}

Keeping my head down, I glanced over with just my eyes and saw Nakano raising his hand, trembling.
"...Excuse me, teacher, I need to go to the restroom."
His face was twisted, and his voice was shaking.
At this school, you aren't allowed to go to the restroom during an exam.
Anyone who goes is treated as having finished the exam, and isn't allowed back into the room until the next exam period.
It was the same when you took it, right?
I know it's to stop cheating, but that's harsh.
I took a quick look at Nakano's answer sheet, and he'd written almost nothing.
He looked like he was about to cry.
He must have been holding it in really badly.
Well, I wasn't much better off.{p}

I was really tempted to get up and leave too.
But I'd hardly done anything on the exam, and with a blank sheet, I'd get a zero for sure.
If anything, Nakano going to the restroom spurred me on, and I kept at it.
I was desperate to fill in the answer sheet, even if the answers were wrong.
Strangely, when I concentrated on the exam, I could hold it in.
That was a new discovery.

The end bell rang just as I finished filling in my answer sheet.
I got up from my seat in a hurry.{p}
I ran along with everyone else rushing to the restrooms.
Go to the same restroom as before
Go to a different restroom

Maybe I was just that desperate, but the idea of going to another restroom never even crossed my mind.
Besides, that restroom was the closest.
And with this many people around, even if hands were reaching out of the restroom, I was bound to be fine.
Telling myself that, I hurried to the restroom.{p}

...There were no hands in the restroom.
Strangely, even the aura that had enveloped the restroom had vanished.
As if nothing had ever happened.
I rushed in first and did my business.
Once I was relieved, a thought suddenly struck me.
What had happened to Nakano?{p}

After third period came lunch break, so I searched all over.
But I couldn't find Nakano anywhere.
Then again, there was a huge crowd, so it wouldn't be strange if I'd missed him.
Nakano might have been looking for me too.
We could have just kept missing each other.{p}

With no other choice, I went back to the exam room and looked for him there too.
But I couldn't find him.{p}

And then, with him still nowhere to be found, the fourth-period exam began.
He didn't come back.
His seat stayed empty while the exam went on.
Once an exam has started, no one is allowed in late, either.
Wherever he'd gone, he ended up abandoning the exam.
I had a strange sense of foreboding.
Maybe something had happened to him.
When the fourth-period exam ended, I was worried, so I went back to that restroom again.{p}

And what do you know?
Those hands were reaching out of the restroom again.
Swaying gently as if in a breeze, the hands seemed to be beckoning to me.
Come to think of it, I hadn't really searched the restroom properly.
Maybe Nakano was still in there.
For some reason, I couldn't shake that feeling.
Should I check?{p}What should I do?
Go into the restroom
Don't go into the restroom

I shut my eyes tight and stepped forward.
The instant I did...{p}

"Urk!"
Suddenly, something bitter welled up in my throat.
Stomach acid surged into my mouth.
It felt like something was pressing hard against my lower belly, and then slowly groping around in there.
It had to be those hands.
Those hands were pushing into my lower belly and stroking it all over.
But I couldn't open my eyes.
I was too scared.
I was afraid the hands right in front of me would crush my head, so I couldn't open my eyes.
Even so, I tried to push forward.
But just trying to move one millimeter further brought on a violent wave of nausea.
Everything in my stomach came back up, until it was completely empty.
I couldn't go any further.
I clapped a hand over my mouth and crouched down on the spot.
But the countless hands blocking the restroom wouldn't let me fall forward.

The hands knocked me back, and I tumbled backward.
That's what saved me, though.{p}

When I fearfully opened my eyes, the hands were gone.
Even now, I get chills when I think what would've happened if those hands had dragged me into the restroom.
Everyone walked past with puzzled looks as I lay there in front of the restroom, staring blankly.
Cold eyes that wanted nothing to do with me.
I was in no state to search the restroom anymore.{p}

I staggered back to the exam room on unsteady legs, took the fifth and final exam, and hurried home.
I haven't seen Nakano since.
I don't even know whether he passed.
But one thing's certain: he never enrolled here.
Now, here's what I think.
Nakano probably just went straight home.
His answer sheet was nearly blank, so he must have realized there was no hope even if he took the next exam.
So he gave up.
That's entirely possible, and I think it's the most reasonable explanation, don't you?
Only, after I enrolled, I heard a rumor about that restroom.{p}

If those were the hands from the rumor, maybe they didn't like me.
Though with something like that, I'd much rather be disliked than liked.
Well, I haven't seen those hands since, and it's only a rumor.
These days, I can go into that restroom without worrying about it at all.
The aura's still as strong as ever, though.{p}

Huh?
Where's that restroom, you ask?{p}
If I told you that, you'd be too scared to use that restroom, wouldn't you?{p}You're better off not asking.
I really want to know
Never mind, I don't need to know

......Oh, all right.
If you can't bring yourself to use the restroom {f:at school|from now on}, don't blame me.
...Truth is, it's all of them.
The restroom I went to that day is the one on the south side of the new school building.
But I think the hands come out of every one of them.
I feel the same kind of aura from every restroom.
I just happened to see them in that one; they could show up in any restroom.{p}

But relax.
You've never seen them even once, right?
Then you'll be fine.
Oh, and spirits never actually harm anyone.
Well, maybe once in a while, but only very, very rarely.
You'll be fine......probably.
That's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

"At this rate, we can't even think about the exam. Let's go in."
"...Yeah."
He looked kind of relieved.
He must have been holding it in pretty badly.
We took a step forward.{p}

Then the hands rippled with a rustle.
They seemed happy to have spotted us.
Like sea anemones swaying in the waves, countless hands stirred.
These things were lying in wait for us.
There was no telling what they'd do if they caught us.
"......Let's not, after all."
I said that and was about to turn back when...{p}
"Waaaagh!"

With a strange scream, Nakano grabbed onto me.
I lost my balance and nearly fell over.
A little annoyed, I looked at him.
And then......I saw several hands wrapped around his legs.
He was looking at me like he was about to cry.
As I stood there flustered, the hands began dragging Nakano along, trying to pull him into the restroom.
Nakano clung to me.
At this rate, I might get dragged in too.{p}What should I do?
Shake Nakano off and run
Pull Nakano along and run away together
I wasn't about to get dragged down with him.

I punched Nakano in the face.
Have you ever punched someone?
It was my first time.
I'll never forget the look on his face then.
He looked shocked, and sad, like he'd been betrayed.{p}

He flinched for a second, and I shook off his hand and ran.
I figured if I could get back to the exam room, I'd be okay.
Just around the next corner was the exam room... and that's when I noticed a strange noise behind me.
A sound like something heavy being dragged: slither... slither...{p}

I had a bad feeling and turned around.
There were the hands, writhing, spread across the entire hallway.
Rearing up like flesh-colored snakes, they were taking aim at me.
They hadn't been after Nakano at all. They'd been after me.
Even so, I couldn't believe they'd leave the restroom and chase me all the way out here.{p}

The exam room wouldn't be any good.
I ran up the stairs.

I figured if I got far enough from that restroom, the hands would give up.
I heard what sounded like a teacher's voice behind me, but I couldn't worry about that.
Because mixed in with my ragged breathing, I could clearly hear that slither... slither... sound.
I think I climbed three or four flights of stairs.
Then an iron door appeared in front of me.{p}

And there they were.
Slither... slither... crawling up the stairs.
Soon they'd catch up to my feet.
The thought terrified me, and I ran all the way to the corner of the roof.
I didn't need to look back to know they were closing in.{p}

Cornered, I climbed the fence.
That's right, the fence on the roof.
But they caught up with me there, too.
Fingertips flickered against my indoor shoes.
There was nowhere left to run.
......Then it hit me.
There was somewhere to run after all.
The endless space spreading out beyond the fence.
You probably think that's crazy.
But back then, I was desperate.{p}

......There was no impact like I'd expected.
Instead, it felt like I'd been gently caught by something soft.
When I opened my eyes, I was being held in midair by lots of hands stretching down from the roof.
While I was still stunned, the hands carefully set me down on the ground.{p}
Then they zipped back up with a swish, as if nothing had happened.{p}

Leaving me all alone in the schoolyard.
The entrance exam?
The teachers decided I'd had a sudden nervous breakdown and gave me a special retest.
Thanks to that, here I am.{p}

...Hee hee, you look puzzled.
You want to ask why I came to this school after such a frightening experience... right?
I told you, didn't I? It must be fate.
For some reason, I must have been chosen by those hands.
I don't know yet what they want me to do.
But I mean to figure that out someday.
And... this is a little hard to say, though.
I can't forget how it felt to be caught by those hands.
So warm, so soft... a sense of security, like I'd become a baby again.
Someday, I want to be wrapped in those hands again...
That's my dream.
That's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

I stomped on the hand gripping Nakano.
When it jerked up with a twitch, Nakano pulled his leg free.{p}

When I looked back as I ran, wouldn't you know it, they were chasing after us.
We hurried down the nearest staircase.
Like water spilling over and dripping down, the hands spread across the whole landing and came slithering down the stairs.
"Outside!"
If we could just make it to the schoolyard, surely they wouldn't be able to catch us.
We tried to burst out through the front entrance.{p}
But right then, Nakano tripped.{p}What do you think I did?
Went back to help Nakano
Abandoned Nakano and ran

We'd run away together; he was like a comrade-in-arms, after all.
I went back to help Nakano without a second thought.
While I was trying to help him up, the hands caught up with us.
On reflex, I pulled a mechanical pencil out of my breast pocket.{p}
And I stabbed it as hard as I could into one of the hands reaching for Nakano's back.

It went in with a nasty, crunching feel.
Just like a real human arm.
It seemed they could feel pain after all, because the hand writhed and squirmed.
The hands around it seemed to flinch, too.{p}

That's when it happened.
With a dull whoosh, a mass of hands came pouring out of every single window.

It was like giant tokoroten noodles squirting out of a press.
Countless hands were beckoning to us.{p}

......After that, I don't remember much.
Apparently, I passed out.
I heard a teacher found us lying collapsed in the schoolyard.
What happened to Nakano after that?
Well, we took the retest together, but...
He seemed like a timid guy, so maybe he was too scared to come here.
But I never saw those hands again after that, either...
I think maybe they gave up on us and went after other prey.
That's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

I may be a soft touch, but not that much of one.
Besides, if Nakano hadn't gone and let his foot get grabbed, none of this would have happened.{p}

As I burst out into the schoolyard, I thought I heard Nakano screaming behind me, though.
In the empty schoolyard, I crouched down.
They had gotten their prey: Nakano.{p}
Hosoda had been telling it with such satisfaction, but suddenly his face clouded over.{p}

"But Nakano is angry about that."
"Huh... So Nakano was saved too?"
{f:I|I} asked, surprised.
From the way he'd just told it, hadn't Nakano been attacked by those hand monsters?
But Hosoda shook his head.{p}

"No, after that, Nakano was just gone.
Maybe those hands ate him, or maybe he slipped into some rift between dimensions......
But you know, at the very end, he got his revenge on me."
Hosoda stood up, his face dark.
"The last thing I heard from Nakano wasn't a scream... It was a curse, aimed at me."
As he spoke, Hosoda took off his shirt.
{f:Slowly|Hey, gross}{f:, he hiked up his undershirt and bared his|! He's turning his bare} back{f: to us.| toward us... Oh!}
On it was a large mark in the shape of a face.
Its brows were knit in resentment and its mouth twisted, as if it were in agony.
"My back turned out like this because those words were hurled at it.
Nobody else can hear it, but I can hear this face's bitter, resentful voice...
Probably for the rest of my life."{p}

"Let's look for another restroom.
There's still time."
"Okay."
He nodded like a little kid.{p}

The instant I stepped into the restroom, I felt something weird and squishy against the whole front of my body.
Even though all I could see in front of me was the inside of a perfectly ordinary restroom.
But I could definitely feel something groping my chest and stomach.
This restroom had to be full of invisible, transparent hands sprouting everywhere☆
Can you imagine how I felt when I realized that?
Shock doesn't even begin to cover it.{p}

Who knew those creepy hands could be invisible sometimes?
I think I let out a pathetic scream.
Once it came to that, I couldn't think about anything at all.
I forgot all about Nakano and tried to bolt out at full speed, flailing both arms around wildly.
But the invisible hands weren't about to let go of me that easily.
The invisible hands grabbed my shirt and dragged me into the restroom, and then they started stroking me all over my body.{p}

Just imagine it.
Even if they were your friends, having a dozen or so friends groping you all over would be unbearably gross, right?
And these were ghost hands.
I was on the verge of passing out.
Honestly, at that point I seriously thought how happy I'd be if I could just faint.

And just as I was really about to pass out, I realized I was screaming without even meaning to.
Not a pathetic scream this time, but a huge one that came booming up from the pit of my stomach.{p}

The moment I did, the hands stroking me flinched for an instant and let go of my body.
I forced my fading consciousness back and threw myself out of the restroom like a baseball player doing a headfirst slide.{p}

The hallway in front of a restroom is always kind of damp, isn't it?
Thanks to slipping on it, I didn't get hurt, but my uniform was soaked through.
But that didn't matter at all.
Then, trying not to look back, I took off running like a shot, desperate to get away from there as fast as I could.
Just then.
I heard a voice behind me calling for help.
"Help me... help me..."
It was Nakano's voice.
A tiny, fading voice, faint as a mosquito's whine, kept coming from inside the restroom over and over, like a record when the needle skips.
I really wanted to go help him, but those invisible hands were definitely still in there.
I hovered helplessly a little way from the restroom entrance, unable to make up my mind whether to go help him or run away.{p}And finally, having made up my mind, I...
Went back to help him
Ran away
Went to get a teacher

And finally, having made up my mind, I started walking toward the restroom.
Timidly, with pathetic little steps.
I hadn't felt it before, but with every step closer, I could feel every little hair on my body standing on end.
I could sense an eerie aura.
It was far stronger than the aura hanging over the exam room, so strong that with every step closer my stomach felt ready to come up.
"Help me... help me, Hosoda..."
Nakano's voice was still coming from inside the restroom.
Holding down the bile rising in my throat, I slowly approached the restroom.
And at last, I made it to the entrance.
Luckily, it seemed the invisible hands couldn't come out as far as the entrance, so they didn't grab me again.
Desperately fighting the urge to run away right then and there, I peeked inside the restroom...{p}

"N-Nakano..."
When I saw that sight, to be honest, I {f:wet myself a little|...}.
{f:Sorry|No}, {f:it's kind of a gross story|I'd better not talk about that}.
Anyway, it was terrible.
Inside the restroom... Nakano had been hoisted up by the invisible hands and was floating in midair.
It looked just like he was being tossed in the air by a cheering crowd.
Except nobody was there holding him up.
Nakano's arms and legs drifted slowly through the air, as if he were spacewalking.
But I could tell he wasn't moving them himself; the invisible hands gripping his arms and legs were moving them like that.
The creepy part was, if you watched Nakano's shirt, you could see the invisible hands moving as they groped all over him.
Every time the invisible hands moved, the creases in his shirt dented into finger shapes and stretched out, and when they touched his face, the flesh of his cheeks sank in.
Watching it, I started to feel like I was the one being touched, and I just couldn't bring myself to look straight at it.{p}

Looking down with my eyes squeezed shut, I called out to Nakano.
"Nakano! Nakano! Scream as loud as you can!
If you do, you'll be able to get away!"
I yelled with everything I had.
"Hosoda... You came for me."
"Never mind that, hurry up and yell as loud as you can.
If you do, they'll get startled and let go of you."
"Okay. Got i..."
After that, all I could hear was muffled mumbling.
Wondering what had happened, I worked up my nerve and looked at Nakano.{p}

And I saw Nakano with his mouth stretched wide open in an unnatural shape, tears spilling from his eyes.
No matter how I looked at it, the only explanation was that fingers had been shoved into his mouth and were prying it open.
I had no idea why they were doing that.
But I think they were probably doing it so the prey they'd finally caught wouldn't get away again.
They must have figured it'd be trouble if he yelled loud like I had and escaped.
Nakano was thrashing desperately to get away too, but it barely looked like he was even squirming.
Then again, he was up against a dozen or so people's worth of hands, so I guess it couldn't be helped.
I couldn't do anything; I just sat there, shaking all over.
You're impressed I didn't run away?
No, that's not it. I wanted to run more than anything, but I guess my legs had given out on me.
My lower body wouldn't listen to me.
Even when I tried to stand up, I had no strength.
Even when I tried to look away, I couldn't take my eyes off what was happening in there.
Even though I was scared out of my mind.
Maybe I'd been struck by some kind of paralysis.{p}

They were about to put Nakano into a stall feet-first.
As he struggled, Nakano seemed to glance into the stall.
The instant he did, his face, already pale with fear, went even whiter.
I couldn't tell what he saw inside the stall, but he must have seen something.
Because up to then, no matter how he struggled, he hadn't budged an inch, but the moment he looked inside, he started thrashing with unbelievable strength.
Nakano's face was twisted with terror.
His eyes were wide open as he desperately tried to escape from something.
His flailing hands groped through the air, as if searching for something to grab on to.
But doing that couldn't keep him from being dragged into the stall.{p}

I guess you could say they were becoming less transparent.
Slowly, steadily, the hands that had been invisible a moment ago began to take on solid form.
Probably because there was a powerful aura hanging inside the stall.
That's how I figured it out: Nakano wasn't floating because he was being held up from below.
How should I put it?
It was like he was being gripped not only from below, of course, but from above and from the sides too.
Dozens of hands, no, maybe even hundreds of hands, were gripping Nakano.
Between the fear and the revulsion, I was on the verge of passing out.
And finally, half of Nakano's body was swallowed into the stall.
He was fighting desperately, but he didn't stand a chance.
At the end, he was sucked in, squelch... squelch..., as if he'd sunk into a bottomless swamp.{p}

That's all I remember.
At some point, I'd passed out.{p}

When I came to, I was lying in a bed in the nurse's office.
Apparently another exam-taker had found me and told a teacher.
The teacher saw my uniform, which had gotten filthy when I dove out of the restroom, and concluded I must have slipped in front of the restroom, hit my head, and passed out.
So it was decided that the wet hallway was the school's responsibility, and they made special arrangements to let me retake the exam at a later date.{p}

Honestly, the thought of coming back to this school made me really reluctant, but I wasn't confident about my entrance exams for other schools either, so I sucked it up and took the exam.
Even during the exam, all I wanted was to go home, so concentrating was out of the question.
But I passed.
And that's why I'm here.{p}

What happened to Nakano?
I don't know.
I haven't seen him since.
Maybe he joined those hands.
You'd better be careful.
{f:When you go to the restroom, I mean|Those hands might show up in the girls' restroom too}.
If you ever get a strange feeling in front of a restroom, don't hesitate: go to a different one.{p}

Or you might get attacked by the hands like we were.
They might be in other restrooms too, though.
The stalls are especially dangerous.
Spirits seem to gather easily in there.
And that's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

Of course I didn't go to that restroom from before.
I ran all the way to the other side of the building.{p}

Sure enough, there were no hands in the restroom there.
I didn't forget to peek inside and make sure nothing was wrong before going in, though.
Once I'd relieved myself, a thought suddenly struck me.
Were the hands still in that first restroom?
Morbid curiosity, I guess.{p}So, what do you think I did?
Went to check that restroom
Decided not to worry about it and went back to the exam room

......
In the end, there were no hands in the restroom.
Strangely, even the aura that had enveloped the restroom so thickly had vanished.
As if nothing had ever happened.
That's when I remembered Nakano.{p}Where could he have gone?
Search the restroom carefully
Search somewhere else

Without the hands, it wasn't that scary.
I tried going inside the restroom.{p}

I couldn't look into the occupied stalls, but I searched everywhere else, from the cleaning-supply locker to every little nook.
When I looked under the sinks, even I thought I might be going a bit overboard.
But Nakano wasn't there.
Break time was running out, the people coming in were giving me funny looks, and I really didn't know what to do.{p}

Then I noticed that one stall had stayed shut the whole time.
